customerDescription:
Deliciously light puff pastry with a seasoned Quorn™ filling.

The most hotly debated sausage roll since, well... the Sausage Roll.

Unless you were living under a very large, very heavy rock for most of 2019, you may have noticed we rustled up some serious feathers for Veganuary that year.

Our Vegan Roll Pork-Free is carefully designed to mirror some of the original Sausage Roll’s classic features, including around 96 layers of deliciously light puff pastry. If it aint broke, right?

BUT… instead we wrap it around our own bespoke filling, developed with the help of our friends over at Quorn™. And, in our humble opinion, it continues to be a gamechanger.

(There have been rare cases of allergic reactions to products containing Mycoprotein. Mycoprotein is made with a member of the fungi/mould family. It is high in protein and fibre which may cause intolerance in some people.)

We’re also proud owners of a Good Egg Award, so you can rest safe knowing our eggy goodness has been well looked after. Doughnut filled with apple and raspberry jam, topped with a pink decorative icing.

steps.description: Take one baguette and slice along the baguette evenly, leaving a hinge at back.
Add 2 medium (black) scoops of Festive premix to the base and spread to the edges with a fork.
Sprinkle 1 small scoop (red) of Crispy Onions evenly across the base and press down with a fork.
Add 1 medium scoop (black) of pulled ham throughout the sandwich and spread with a fork.
Add 3 quarter slices of Cheese onto the base.
Place sandwich into festive hot baguette packaging, seal at the front with product label and apply PPDS to the back.

steps.description: Slice evenly along the length of the baguette leaving a hinge at the back

menuDescription: Smoked sweetcure bacon, pork sausage, Cheddar cheese, cranberry & red onion relish in white bread made with sourdough, topped with béchamel and a blend of cheeses. Find a moment in the frantic festive period to tuck into this.

steps.description: Take 2 slices of Sourdough Bloomer.
Add 1 small scoop (red) of Cranberry Relish and spread to edges with a spatula.
Cut 2 sausages in half length-ways and place onto the sandwich.
Place 2 slices of Sweetcure bacon on top of the sausages.
Place 2 quarter slices of Cheddar Cheese, vertically on top of the Sweetcure Bacon.
Add the lid and apply  ½ a small scoop (red) of Bechamel Sauce and spread evenly with a spatula.
Add 1 medium scoop (black) of New Grated Cheese Blend on top of Bechamel Sauce, spread evenly and press down to the edges.
Place the uncooked Toastie in festive Toastie packaging, seal at the front with product label and apply PPDS to the back.
